sentence: Although the first weeks in a foreign country were unsettling, most exchange students slowly ____ to the local climate, the spicy food and the slower rhythm of daily life.
note: acclimatize 指逐渐适应新气候，常与 to 连用；assimilate 指融入某文化群体，须与 into 搭配；accumulate 是积累，accelerate 是加速，都与适应环境无关。

sentence: Although she had dreamed of studying abroad, by the third week she felt so ____ that she called her mother every evening and slept with a photo of home beside her bed.
note: homesick 指离家在外思念家人；seasick 是晕船，carsick 是晕车，都指身体不适；lovesick 指因相思而憔悴，与想念家乡无关。

sentence: Rather than tinkering with individual courses, the department redrew the entire four-year ____, adding a compulsory internship in the third year and a research project in the fourth.
note: curriculum 指一个专业或学位的整体课程体系，可被“重新设计”；syllabus 是单门课的教学大纲，prospectus 是招生简章，transcript 是成绩单，都不能用 four-year 修饰。

sentence: On the first day the professor handed out a detailed ____ for the course, listing the weekly readings, the weight of each assignment, the dates of both midterms and the rules on late work.
note: syllabus 指某门课的教学大纲，列明阅读、评分权重与考试日期；curriculum 是整体课程体系，seminar 指研讨课本身，transcript 是已修课程的成绩单。

sentence: Graduate schools usually ask for an official ____ showing every course you have taken and the grade you received in each one.
note: transcript 指逐门记录已修课程与分数的官方成绩单；certificate 是证书，diploma 是毕业文凭，portfolio 是作品集，都不列课程与具体分数。

sentence: More than four hundred students ____ on the new data science course within the first hour of registration.
note: enroll on a course 表示注册选修某门课；enlist 指出兵役或争取支持，entail 是牵涉、势必导致，enclose 是随信附上，都不能接 on the course。

sentence: The number of ____ at the college has fallen by half since the new tutoring program began offering free help with math and writing.
note: dropout 指没读完就退学的学生，可被辅导计划减少；drop-off 指数量下滑或让人下车的地点，breakdown 指故障或崩溃，turnover 指人员流动率。

sentence: Because three of her courses required weekly essays, the first-year student found the ____ far heavier than anything she had faced at high school.
note: workload 指要完成的工作或课业量，可用 heavier 形容；workforce 是劳动力，workshop 是工作坊，workmanship 是手艺、做工，均不能指课业负担。

sentence: Instead of starting the term paper in week three, he ____ until the night before it was due and then drank six cups of coffee in a row.
note: procrastinate 是不及物动词，指一再拖延；postpone 是及物动词，后面必须接被推迟的事；predominate 是占优势，participate 须与 in 连用。

sentence: Realizing that half the class was still collecting data, the professor moved the ____ back by two days so that nobody would hand in rubbish.
note: deadline 指必须交差的最后期限，move it back 即延后；headline 是新闻标题，baseline 是基准线，guideline 是指导方针，都不能被延后两天。

sentence: Students who ____ an entire textbook into a single night usually remember very little of it a week later, which is why spaced review works better.
note: cram 指考前把大量内容硬塞进脑子，常与 into 连用；skim 是略读，scan 是扫读找信息，recite 是背诵，都不能表示把整本书塞进一晚。

sentence: Most first-year students share a room in a ____ on the north side of the campus, a ten-minute walk from the main library and the dining hall.
note: dormitory 指学生住宿的宿舍楼，可与 share a room 搭配；laboratory 是实验室，refectory 是食堂，auditorium 是礼堂，都不能住人。

sentence: When her ____ began practicing the violin at midnight, she bought a pair of earplugs and a small white-noise machine so she could sleep.
note: roommate 指同住一间屋的室友，才会半夜在屋里练琴；classmate 是同班同学，teammate 是队友，workmate 是同事，都不与人合住。

sentence: After failing two midterms in a single week, he booked an appointment with the campus ____, who helped him draw up a realistic study plan.
note: counselor 指学校里负责疏导和学业规划的辅导员；councilor 是议员或委员，chancellor 是校长，cashier 是收银员，都不帮学生制定学习计划。

sentence: Talking to her tutor helped her turn the constant ____ about grades into a manageable weekly routine of short, focused study sessions.
note: anxiety 指对未来不确定之事的持续担忧，与 sleepless、racing heartbeat 相合。tension 多指气氛或肌肉的紧张；eagerness 是急切期待；curiosity 是好奇，都不伴随失眠与心跳加速这类焦虑症状。

sentence: The sheer number of reading lists, club fairs and social invitations can ____ a new student in the first week, so most universities now run a short orientation course.
meaning: 使不堪承受；使不知所措
note: overwhelm 指事情太多让人不知所措，与后面的入学导引课呼应；overtake 是超过或（情绪）突然袭来，overlap 是重叠，overlook 是忽略。

sentence: Constant comparison with high-achieving classmates can slowly damage a teenager's ____, until they become convinced that they are simply not good enough.
note: self-esteem 指对自身价值的评价，会因不断比较而受损；self-control 是自我克制，self-defence 是自卫，self-interest 是自身利益，都不由此受损。

sentence: The university pairs every new student with a mentor from the same year, since advice from ____ often feels more useful than advice from staff.
note: peers 指同一年龄或同一阶段的人，与 from the same year 一致；pupils 是相对老师而言的学生，rivals 是对手，elders 是长辈，都不合。

sentence: The new girl found it hard to break into the ____ that had formed among the girls who had known one another since primary school.
note: clique 指排外的小圈子，常与 break into 搭配；club 是正式社团，click 是点击或咔嗒声，class 是班级，都不含排外意味。

sentence: For months he was ____ at school, his lunch money taken and his homework torn up in front of the class, until a teacher finally noticed.
note: bullied 指长期被欺凌，与钱被抢走、作业被撕相符；teased 只是取笑，程度太轻；blamed 是被责怪，ignored 是被忽视，都与被抢钱撕作业不符。

sentence: The orientation week is designed to create a sense of ____ among first-year students, many of whom arrive knowing nobody on a campus of thirty thousand people.
note: belonging 指被群体接纳的归属感，正是迎新周要营造的；longing 是渴望，belongings 是随身物品，loneliness 是孤独，与 create 的目的相反。

sentence: Students who move from a small town to a big city often need a term or two to ____ to the noise, the crowds and the faster rhythm of daily life.
note: adapt 与 to 连用表示逐渐适应新环境；adopt 是采纳、收养，admit 是承认，absorb 是吸收，都不能接 to 表示适应。

sentence: Learning to ____ with a heavy reading load is one of the skills that first-year students have to pick up quickly, or they fall behind within weeks.
note: cope with 是固定搭配，指应付困难或压力；copy 是复制，cure 是治愈（cure sb of sth），care 是关心，都不能与 with 搭配表示应对。

sentence: The app was designed to help new students ____ a campus of forty buildings without stopping strangers to ask for directions.
note: navigate 指在陌生大环境里辨明方向、顺利穿行；negotiate 指谈判或小心越过障碍物，nominate 是提名，cultivate 是培养，都与找路无关。

sentence: Many students ____ a part-time job, sports training and a full course load, and something usually has to give before the term ends.
note: juggle 指同时应付几件都难放下的事，常接多项宾语；struggle 是不及物动词，不能直接接三样事物；jostle 是推挤，jumble 是弄乱。

sentence: If you revise with your phone face-up on the desk, every notification becomes a ____, and the two hours you set aside shrink to forty minutes of real work.
note: distraction 指让人从学习中分心的事物，与手机通知呼应；distinction 是区别，distortion 是歪曲，discretion 是自行决定权，都不会缩短学习时间。

sentence: Failing the first driving test was only a temporary ____; she booked another appointment the same afternoon and passed it two weeks later.
note: setback 指进展中遇到的暂时挫折；drawback 是缺点、不利条件，comeback 是复出、东山再起，offset 是抵消，都不能用 temporary 形容考试失利。

sentence: Because the course requires three drafts, students receive plenty of ____ from the instructor and from classmates before the final version is graded.
note: feedback 指对初稿提出的反馈意见，不可数，正好与 plenty of 搭配；background 是背景，outcome 是结果，layout 是版面设计，都不由师生提意见。

sentence: Two students were accused of ____ after the software matched whole paragraphs of their essays to an article published online last year.
note: plagiarism 指把别人的文字当作自己的，与软件查出整段雷同相符；criticism 是批评，journalism 是新闻业，tourism 是旅游业，都与抄袭无关。

sentence: The department runs a weekly ____ at which two graduate students present their work and the rest of the group questions every assumption in it.
note: seminar 指人数不多、需要轮流报告并相互质疑的研讨课；semester 是学期，ceremony 是典礼，rehearsal 是排练，都不涉及学术报告。

sentence: His two-hour ____ on the history of the city drew such a crowd that latecomers had to stand at the back of the hall.
note: lecture 指教师面向大量听众的系统讲授，才会挤到有人站着听；seminar 与 tutorial 都是小班课，workshop 是实践工作坊，人数不会爆满。

sentence: She spent the whole summer collecting data for her master's ____, which examines how bilingual children learn to read in two writing systems.
note: thesis 指硕士或博士学位论文，可由 master's 直接修饰；theory 是理论，theme 是主题，hypothesis 是尚待验证的假设，都不是提交的论文。

sentence: She won a full ____ that covers fees, books and accommodation, which means her parents no longer have to borrow money at the start of each term.
note: scholarship 指凭成绩获得、按“全额”发放的奖学金；sponsorship 是商业赞助，citizenship 是公民身份，membership 是会员资格，都不能支付学费住宿。

sentence: Because ____ at private universities has risen much faster than wages, many graduates spend a decade repaying their student loans.
note: tuition 指大学收取的学费，上涨才逼学生贷款；intuition 是直觉，instruction 是教学、指示，institution 是机构，都不能表示收费上涨。

sentence: The ____ voted overwhelmingly to cut class sizes, though the administration warned that hiring more teachers would raise costs.
note: faculty 指大学的全体教师，可以投票表态；facility 是设施，factory 是工厂，familiarity 是熟悉、了解，都不能投票决定班级规模。

sentence: The new library stands at the centre of the ____, within easy reach of every hall of residence and every department.
note: campus 指大学的校园范围，图书馆正居其中；compass 是指南针，canvas 是帆布、画布，caucus 是党派核心会议，都不指校园。

sentence: Universities increasingly value ____ activities such as volunteering and student government, because they show how a candidate works with other people.
note: extracurricular 指课堂之外的活动，常修饰 activities；compulsory 是必修的，vocational 是职业的，academic 是学业课堂内的，都不能概括志愿服务与学生会。

sentence: Rather than spending every Saturday shopping, she ____ at the campus food bank, sorting donations and packing boxes for families in the neighborhood.
note: volunteer 指自愿出时间做事，与后面的分类、装箱等出力动作相符；donate 和 contribute 都是捐钱捐物，participate 须与 in 连用。

sentence: The student ____ meets every other Tuesday to decide how the club budget should be split among the societies.
note: committee 指经推选组成、负责议事的委员会，可“每两周开会”；commitment 是承诺，commodity 是商品，community 是社区，都不能开会分预算。

sentence: Lacking any real ____ to study, he would sit at his desk for three hours, sharpen pencils and finish almost nothing.
note: motivation 指推动学习的内在动力，可与 lacking 搭配；momentum 指已形成的势头（须先有进展），movement 是运动，motion 是动作或动议。
